answer.summary: Your Drowned Dome Colony is planned as ten buildings on a deep, flat patch of sea floor. A great central dome sits in the hub of a ring. Around it stand four residential pods, the kelp farm dome, the forge, the market dome, the observation tower and an air-lock gatehouse. Architect can't build under water yet, so the sea-floor site and the colony wait. Nothing is built until that support arrives.
